focus_areas: Digit count and separation on forelimbs and hindlimbs (via topology segmentation)
Iris detail and eye realism (via perceptual zoom)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the forelimb digits. Do they clearly show four separate, blunt toes? Or do they appear fused/melted into the moss? Use the topology boundary auditor to definitively separate the limb pixels from the background. Also, examine the eye closely: is there any evidence of gold flecks in the iris, or is it just a black dot? These are the primary failure points for AI-generated salamanders.
image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) traversing a textured surface of green moss and brown earth. The salamander features a glossy, jet-black skin with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots distributed along its dorsal side and flanks. The body is robust and cylindrical. The head is visible on the right, showing a broad shape, while the tail curves towards the left. One forelimb and one hindlimb are planted on the ground, partially obscured by the terrain texture.
